hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve Uniswap v4 hook that bypasses concentrated liquidity by handling all swap logic in beforeSwap: it takes input tokens from the PoolManager, deposits them into an Euler lending vault, and withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, enforcing a custom reserve curve. Pool instances are deployed as delegatecall proxies over the EulerSwap implementation.
